periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 45 degrees downward and outward from the medial canthus region.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a longitudinal axis significantly longer than the transverse width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced inferior tapering, resulting in a teardrop morphology with the lowest point shifted below the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Deep V-shaped indentation at the posterior midline, creating a bi-lobed or heart-shaped upper border.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick band, occupying approximately 35-40% of the visible dorsal-to-caudal torso length at the lateral margins.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: A distinct white gap on the crown approximately equal to the horizontal width of a single pinna region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly convex and rounded curvature at the superior boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: The posterior margin of the black shoulder band features a sharp, symmetrical notch pointing towards the head.
